ex.t: 公共假日通常按周日时刻表运行。

defs.def: the time when it is exactly 1 o'clock, 2 o'clock, etc. 整点
（按 24 小时制给出的时间，通常用于军事或其他官方用语）点钟

ex.s: Then, on two separate morning visits to the scientists’ lab, each man walked for an hour at an average speed that, in theory should allow his body to rely mainly on fat for fuel.
ex.t: 他们首先找到了10名超重且不活跃但其他方面健康的年轻男性，他们的生活方式——无论好坏——代表了大多数人的生活方式。

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市法克托里亚大道上的交通信号灯通常不会连续两次亮相同时长的绿灯，尤其是在高峰时段。
